title: What If the Moon Disappeared Tonight?

scenes.text: What if the Moon vanished tonight? The first thing you'd notice isn't the dark.
The tides. Most of them come from the Moon. Within a day the oceans would rise and fall less than half as much.
Nights would be about ten times darker. Owls, turtles and coral that breed by moonlight would lose their clock.
Then the slow part. The Moon steadies Earth's tilt. Without it, over millions of years, the tilt could swing wildly.
Seasons could flip between none at all and ice at the equator.
And our days would stop getting longer. The Moon's pull adds about two milliseconds every century. Gone with it.

description:
What if the Moon disappeared tonight?
Smaller tides within a day, darker nights, and over millions of years a planet whose tilt — and seasons — swing wildly.
